name: Which model can write the query circuits: gpt-6-luna against quantized and larger Qwen3 models, same prompt and loop, no fine-tuning
registered_by: query-model-calibration-agent (owner question of 2026-10-01: 'instead of Luna, can a decent quantized Qwen 4B, or a bigger model, write our query circuits?')
kind: evaluation-only: no training and no fine-tuning; every model is used as published, prompted by lib/query-author; local models run on this machine's GPU through llama.cpp (one GPU worker at a time) and, for the 4B, on CPU; larger models run through OpenRouter (paid, total cap 5 USD)
frozen_before_results: Written before any model was run on any dev row. The prompt, the validate-and-repair loop and the scoring are fixed by lib/query-author (coding-agent-query-agent) and tools/eval/query-model-calibration/ and are identical for every model; a change after the first stage is a recorded deviation and restarts the affected stage for all models.

system_under_test.task: message (English question) -> query circuit (a SOP query wire over the vocabulary of the base memory world-v1) written by the model through lib/query-author (prompt: message + memory vocabulary + condensed authoring guide; validate-and-repair loop, at most the library's maximum fix rounds)

models.local_gguf_cpu: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, 20-question sample, 4 threads (the laptop thread count of cpu-speed-table.json)

system_under_test.settings: non-thinking or instruct mode wherever the model offers one (Qwen3 base-hybrid models: enable_thinking false); temperature 0; the settings of every model are written into its row of the report
system_under_test.memory: base memory world-v1 (English-only, rebuilt on core-en), loaded in a private chat data root; the product slice path and the oracle answer the executed circuit

data.dev: the dev set of query forms with gold circuits and oracle gold answers (tools/eval/query-forms/, experiment eval-query-forms-v1, by query-surface-agent) plus the 30 questions of eval/world-kb/questions.json on world-v1. The sealed KBQA suites (eval/suites/kbqa-*) are never used.
data.gold: the answer set the oracle returns on world-v1 for the gold circuit; the LLM never decides the gold. A produced circuit counts as correct only if its executed answer set (or count, or yes/no) equals the gold answer set.

hypotheses.H1: A quantized Qwen3-4B-Instruct (Q4_K_M or Q8_0), prompted by lib/query-author with validate-and-repair, reaches an executed-correct rate within 5 percentage points of gpt-6-luna on the one-hop and count forms.
hypotheses.H2: The gap to Luna widens on superlative, comparative, multi-hop and measure forms; a 14B to 32B Qwen3 closes it (within 5 pp overall).
hypotheses.H3: End to end per question, a local 4B on this GPU is not slower than Luna through omp (agent start-up dominates Luna); on CPU the 4B is slower than Luna but the circuits are short, so rounds and start-up matter more than tokens per second.

metrics.primary: executed-correct % per model (and per form: one-hop, count, superlative, comparative, multi-hop, measure) = produced circuit executed on world-v1 gives the gold answer / n
secondary: wrong % (a definite answer different from the gold)
latency per question end to end (wall clock from message in to validated circuit out; p50, p95), split into start-up, prompt processing, generation and repair rounds
tokens per second on this GPU and on CPU
cost per 100 questions (OpenRouter invoice; Luna nominal list price, not an invoice)
metrics.intervals: Wilson 95% for proportions; paired bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261001) of the difference in executed-correct against gpt-6-luna and against Qwen3-4B Q8_0 on the same questions

decision_rule.recommendation: the cheapest model (by cost per 100 questions for a paid model, else by model size and end-to-end latency on the target hardware) whose executed-correct is within 5 percentage points of gpt-6-luna on the full set, with the paired bootstrap lower bound of the difference above -10 pp and a wrong rate not above Luna's wrong rate plus 2 pp. If none qualifies, Luna stays and the best local model is named with its gap.

stopping_rules.stage_1: the first 50 questions (stratified by form, fixed seed 20261001) for every model
stopping_rules.stage_2: all questions, only for models that survive stage 1
drop_after_stage_1: clearly dominated: the paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound of (model - Qwen3-4B Q8_0) executed-correct below 0 while the model is not cheaper or faster, or the upper bound of (model - gpt-6-luna) below -20 pp
stopping_rules.broken_condition: more than 20% of the first 50 outputs empty or unparsable for a model: stop that model, record it
stopping_rules.budget: OpenRouter spend is tracked per call; the run stops at 5 USD in total
stopping_rules.recording: every stop is recorded in the journal, a topic note, the experiment record and the task page, with stage, numbers and reason
